3234-3293-5256-5414.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5256-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5256-5414.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

Resolve Progenitor Mimic's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Progenitor Mimic's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Zombie, putting a +1/+1 counter on Umbral Collar Zealot.
Repeat.

Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Pirated Copy by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.

215-2757-3652-5705.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Ornithopter, untapping the Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the Forest.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If desired, once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to get infinite {C}, and then you may forego tapping or sacrificing them on future iterations to get infinite creature tokens.

Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain one life.

Black Market has at least seven charge counters on it.

 When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Bloodghast trigger.
